40016027.author: पदार्थः
40016027.content: तदा then, तरस्विनाम् courageous, नर्दताम् increasing, तेषांवानराणाम् by those Vanaras, सुतुमुलम् tumultuous noise, शब्दम् sound, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसैःसार्धम् all Rakshasas, शुश्राव heard.

40016027.author: Translation
40016027.content: Then Ravana and all the Rakshasas heard the increasing and highly tumultuous sound made by the courageous Vanaras.

40016028.author: पदार्थः
40016028.content: ततः thereafter, सः he, स्निग्धगम्भीरनिर्घोषम् deep and loud sound, निनदम् roaring, भृशम् swiftly, श्रुत्वा having heard, तेषाम् to them, सचिवानाम् ministers, मध्ये midst, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40016028.author: Translation
40016028.content: Thereafter, hearing the loud and deep sounds of roaring and seeing his (Ravana's) ministers in the midst, he spoke as follows.

40016029.author: पदार्थः
40016029.content: सम्प्रहृष्टानाम् very happy, बहूनाम् many of them, वानराणाम् Vanaras, समुत्थित collected:, सुमहान् very great, असौ such, नादः sound, गर्जताम् roaring, मेघानामिव like thunder of rumbling clouds, यथा just as, श्रूयते, सुव्यक्तम् , एतेषाम् by that, प्रीतिः happiness, सुमहती huge, अत्र there, संशयः doubt, न no, तथाहि for that reason, विपुलैः wide, नादैः noise, वरुणालयः ocean, चुक्षुभे agitated.

40016029.author: Translation
40016029.content: "Many Vanaras have collected together and roared making loud noises just as thunder rumbling clouds. By that there is no doubt that they are very happy. For that reason, even the wide ocean is agitated."

40016030.author: पदार्थः
40016030.content: सम्प्रहृष्टानाम् very happy, बहूनाम् many of them, वानराणाम् Vanaras, समुत्थित collected:, सुमहान् very great, असौ such, नादः sound, गर्जताम् roaring, मेघानामिव like thunder of rumbling clouds, यथा just as, श्रूयते, सुव्यक्तम् , एतेषाम् by that, प्रीतिः happiness, सुमहती huge, अत्र there, संशयः doubt, न no, तथाहि for that reason, विपुलैः wide, नादैः noise, वरुणालयः ocean, चुक्षुभे agitated.

40016030.author: Translation
40016030.content: "Many Vanaras have collected together and roared making loud noises just as thunder rumbling clouds. By that there is no doubt that they are very happy. For that reason, even the wide ocean is agitated."

40016031.author: पदार्थः
40016031.content: भ्रातरौ brothers, तौरामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrows, बद्धौ are bound, सुमहान् great, अयंनादः such sound I hear, मे to me, शङ्काम् doubt, जनयतीव in my mind.

40016031.author: Translation
40016031.content: "The two brothers Rama and Lakshmana are bound by sharp arrows. By the loud noise that I hear I doubt in my mind!"

40016032.author: पदार्थः
40016032.content: राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, मन्त्रिणः to ministers, एतत्तु such, वचनम् words, तु you, उक्त्वा having spoken, तत्र there, समीपपरिवर्तिनः waiting near, नैरृतान् to Rakshasas, उवाच said.

40016032.author: Translation
40016032.content: Having spoken like that to the ministers, the Lord of Rakshasas said to the Rakshasas who stood waiting close by.

40016033.author: पदार्थः
40016033.content: एतेषाम् for what reason, सर्वेषाम् all of them, वनचारिणाम् rangers of woods, शोककाले in the time for grief, समुत्पन्न arisen, तूर्णम् speedily, हर्षकारणमुत्थितम् reason for rejoicing, ज्ञायताम् be found out.

40016033.author: Translation
40016033.content: "For what reason are the Vanaras (rangers of woods) rejoicing that way in the time of grief? It may be found out speedily."

40016034.author: पदार्थः
40016034.content: तथा as, उक्ताः having said, ते his, नसम्भ्रान्ताः bewildered, प्राकारम् the boundary wall, अधिरुह्य scaling, महात्मना great, सुग्रीवेण to Sugriva, पालिताम् protected by, सेनाम् army, सुघोरेण at a distance, शरबन्धेन bound by arrows, मुक्तौ relieved, समुत्थितौ happy, महाभागौ prosperous, तौराघवौ them, the Raghavas, ददृशुः beheld, प्रेक्षराक्षसाः Rakshasas saw, विषेदुः worried.

40016034.author: Translation
40016034.content: Ravana having said so, the bewildered Rakshasas scaling the boundary wall beheld the army protected by great Sugriva and the prosperous Raghavas relieved from arrows and happy, he became worried.

40016035.author: पदार्थः
40016035.content: तथा as, उक्ताः having said, ते his, नसम्भ्रान्ताः bewildered, प्राकारम् the boundary wall, अधिरुह्य scaling, महात्मना great, सुग्रीवेण to Sugriva, पालिताम् protected by, सेनाम् army, सुघोरेण at a distance, शरबन्धेन bound by arrows, मुक्तौ relieved, समुत्थितौ happy, महाभागौ prosperous, तौराघवौ them, the Raghavas, ददृशुः beheld, प्रेक्षराक्षसाः Rakshasas saw, विषेदुः worried.

40016035.author: Translation
40016035.content: Ravana having said so, the bewildered Rakshasas scaling the boundary wall beheld the army protected by great Sugriva and the prosperous Raghavas relieved from arrows and happy, he became worried.

40016036.author: पदार्थः
40016036.content: घोराः dreadful, सर्वे all, तेवदनाः their countenance, सन्त्रस्तहृदयाः frightened at heart, विषण्णाः pale faces, प्राकारात् boundary, अवरुह्य getting down, राक्षसेन्द्रम् to the Lord of Rakshasas, उपस्थिताः reached.

40016036.author: Translation
40016036.content: All the dreadful Rakshasas getting down the boundary wall with pale faces, sad countenance reached the Lord of Rakshasas.

40016037.author: पदार्थः
40016037.content: वाक्यकोविदाः capable of talking, निशाचराः Rakshasas, दीनमुखाः desperate, अप्रियम् unpleasant, तत् those, कृत्स्नम् dark, यथावत् as it is, रावणस्य to Ravana, न्यवेदयन् presented.

40016037.author: Translation
40016037.content: Rakshasas who were well versed in talking, desperately conveyed the unpleasantness as it is to Ravana.

40016038.author: पदार्थः
40016038.content: युद्धे in the battlefield, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajith, भ्रातरौ brothers, यौ those, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, शरबन्धेन from the bondage of arrows, निबद्धौ have been set free, निष्प्रकम्पभुजौ shoulders relieved, कृतौ done, गजेन्द्रसमविक्रमौ powerful elephants, तौ they, पाशान् rope, छित्वा snapped, गजौइव like elephants, रणाजिरे like elephant heroes, दृश्येते are seen.

40016038.author: Translation
40016038.content: "The two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, who are like powerful elephants have been set free from the bondage of arrows of Indrajith in the battlefield. Their shoulders are relieved and are like elephants snapped off the rope binding them."

40016039.author: पदार्थः
40016039.content: युद्धे in the battlefield, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajith, भ्रातरौ brothers, यौ those, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, शरबन्धेन from the bondage of arrows, निबद्धौ have been set free, निष्प्रकम्पभुजौ shoulders relieved, कृतौ done, गजेन्द्रसमविक्रमौ powerful elephants, तौ they, पाशान् rope, छित्वा snapped, गजौइव like elephants, रणाजिरे like elephant heroes, दृश्येते are seen.

40016039.author: Translation
40016039.content: "The two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, who are like powerful elephants have been set free from the bondage of arrows of Indrajith in the battlefield. Their shoulders are relieved and are like elephants snapped off the rope binding them."

40016040.author: पदार्थः
40016040.content: महाबलः of mighty prowess, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, तेषाम् by that, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा hearing, चिन्तारोषसमाक्रान्तः very worried and enraged, विषण्णवदनः pale face, अभवत् remained.

40016040.author: Translation
40016040.content: The Rakshasa king endowed with mighty prowess became pale in face, worried and enraged on hearing the words of Rakshasas.

40016041.author: पदार्थः
40016041.content: घोरैः dreadful, दत्तवरैः blessed with boons, आशीविषोपमैः like sharp poisonous snakes, अमोघैः amazing, सूर्यसङ्काशैः bright like the sun, शरैः arrows, युधि in battle, प्रमध्य violently, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajith, बद्धौ bound by, ममरिपू our enemies, तत् that, अस्त्रबन्धम् bondage by the arrows, आसाद्य formidable, मुक्तौयदि to liberate, इदम् this, सर्वम् everything, बलम् army, संशयस्थम् doubt, अहम् I am, अनुपश्यामि perceive.

40016041.author: Translation
40016041.content: "My enemies who are bound by the formidable and unfailing, sharp, poisonous and bright arrows like the sun of Indrajith blessed with boons, are liberated from the bondage! I doubt if my army is in danger!"

40016042.author: पदार्थः
40016042.content: घोरैः dreadful, दत्तवरैः blessed with boons, आशीविषोपमैः like sharp poisonous snakes, अमोघैः amazing, सूर्यसङ्काशैः bright like the sun, शरैः arrows, युधि in battle, प्रमध्य violently, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajith, बद्धौ bound by, ममरिपू our enemies, तत् that, अस्त्रबन्धम् bondage by the arrows, आसाद्य formidable, मुक्तौयदि to liberate, इदम् this, सर्वम् everything, बलम् army, संशयस्थम् doubt, अहम् I am, अनुपश्यामि perceive.

40016042.author: Translation
40016042.content: "My enemies who are bound by the formidable and unfailing, sharp, poisonous and bright arrows like the sun of Indrajith blessed with boons, are liberated from the bondage! I doubt if my army is in danger!"

40016043.author: पदार्थः
40016043.content: तैः they, सङ्ग्रामे in battlefield, मम me, रिपूणाम् enemies, जीवितम् life, अदत्तम् taken away, वासुकितेजसः of equal brilliance as Vasuki, शराः arrows, निष्फलाः wasted, सम्वृत्ताःखलु become in fructuous now.

40016043.author: Translation
40016043.content: "My arrows which are equal in brilliance to Vasuki by which my enemies' life was taken away has become in fructuous now."

40016044.author: पदार्थः
40016044.content: एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, सङ्क्रुद्धः enraged, यथा just like, निश्श्वसन् hissing, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, मध्ये midst, धूम्राक्षंनाम called Dhumraksha, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, अब्रवीत् said.

40016044.author: Translation
40016044.content: Having said so, hissing Ravana called Dhumraksha to the midst.

40016045.author: पदार्थः
40016045.content: भीमविक्रमः of fierce prowess, त्वम् you, महता huge, बलेन army, राक्षसैः of Rakshasas, युक्तः able, वानरैःसह along with Vanaras, रामस्य and Rama also, वधाय destroying, अभि now, निर्याहि commanded.

40016045.author: Translation
40016045.content: "Dhumraksha of fierce prowess, you along with a huge Rakshasa army go just now to destroy Rama along with able Vanaras."

40016046.author: पदार्थः
40016046.content: धीमता Intelligent, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the Lord of Rakshasas, एवम् in that manner, उक्तः ordered by, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, प्रणाम् prayers, कृत्वा having offered, नृपालयत् from the king, सम्हृष्ट: joyful, निर्जगाम went from there.

40016046.author: Translation
40016046.content: Commanded by the Intelligent king of Rakshasas in that manner, Dhumraksha offered prayers and went from there joyfully.

40016047.author: पदार्थः
40016047.content: तद् thereafter, द्वारम् from the gateway, अभिनिष्क्रम्य went from there, बलाध्यक्षम् commander inchief of the army, उवाचह said so, तूर्णम् Instantly, बलम् army, युयुत्सतः get ready, त्वरयस्व speedily, चिरेण delay, किम् why.

40016047.author: Translation
40016047.content: There after Dhumraksha went from the gateway and said to the CommanderinChief of the army" Get ready immediately and start quickly. Why delay?"

40016048.author: पदार्थः
40016048.content: बलानुगः large army contingent, बलाध्यक्षः CommanderinChief of army, धूम्राक्षवचनम् Dhumraksha's words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, रावणस्य Ravana's, आज्ञया by the order, द्रुतम् quickly, बलम् army, उद्योजयामास got ready.

40016048.author: Translation
40016048.content: On hearing the words of Dhumraksha, the CommanderinChief of the large army, he got ready quickly by the order of Ravana.

40016049.author: पदार्थः
40016049.content: बद्धघण्टाः bound with girdles of bells, बलिनः mighty, घोररूपाः of fierce, तेनिशाचराः the Rakshasa, विगर्जमाना roaring, सम्हृष्टाः joyfully, धूम्राक्षम् with Dhumraksha, पर्यवारयन् surrounded.

40016049.author: Translation
40016049.content: Mighty army bound with girdles of bells to their waist, of fierce form roaring surrounded Dhumraksha joyfully.

40016050.author: पदार्थः
40016050.content: जलदायथा like rain clouds, नर्दन्तः roaring, घोराः dreadful, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, विविधायुधहस्ताश्च holding different kinds of weapons, शूलमुद्गरपाणयः tridents, spikes, गदाभिः maces too, पट्टसै: iron spears, दण्डैः rods, आयसैः armour, मुसलैरपि even clubs, परिघैः iron bars, भिण्डिवापालैश्च slings use for hurling stones, भल्लैः arrows, प्रासै: darts, परश्वधैः in thousands, निर्ययुः set out.

40016050.author: Translation
40016050.content: The dreadful Rakshasas set out roaring like rain clouds armed with different kinds of weapons, like tridents, darts, maces, spears, iron bars, rods, even clubs, spears and slings, arrows in thousands.

40016051.author: पदार्थः
40016051.content: जलदायथा like rain clouds, नर्दन्तः roaring, घोराः dreadful, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, विविधायुधहस्ताश्च holding different kinds of weapons, शूलमुद्गरपाणयः tridents, spikes, गदाभिः maces too, पट्टसै: iron spears, दण्डैः rods, आयसैः armour, मुसलैरपि even clubs, परिघैः iron bars, भिण्डिवापालैश्च slings use for hurling stones, भल्लैः arrows, प्रासै: darts, परश्वधैः in thousands, निर्ययुः set out.

40016051.author: Translation
40016051.content: The dreadful Rakshasas set out roaring like rain clouds armed with different kinds of weapons, like tridents, darts, maces, spears, iron bars, rods, even clubs, spears and slings, arrows in thousands.

40016052.author: पदार्थः
40016052.content: अन्ये and others, कवचिनः holding shields, ध्वजैः flags, समलङ्कृतैः collected together, सुवर्णजालविहितैः with golden mesh, विविधाननैः many kinds, खरैश्च donkeys, रथैः chariots, परमशीघ्रैः very fast, हयैश्च horses also, मदोत्कटैः maddened, गजैश्चैव and elephants, व्याघ्राःइव like tigers, and horses दुरासदाः frightful, निर्ययुर्नैरृतव्याघ्रा fearless like tigers, निर्ययुः set out.

40016052.author: Translation
40016052.content: And others collected together holding shields, fearless like tigers, frightful in appearance, mounted on fast horses, chariots yoked to donkeys of different kinds covered with gold mesh, on maddened elephants Set out.

40016053.author: पदार्थः
40016053.content: अन्ये and others, कवचिनः holding shields, ध्वजैः flags, समलङ्कृतैः collected together, सुवर्णजालविहितैः with golden mesh, विविधाननैः many kinds, खरैश्च donkeys, रथैः chariots, परमशीघ्रैः very fast, हयैश्च horses also, मदोत्कटैः maddened, गजैश्चैव and elephants, व्याघ्राःइव like tigers, and horses दुरासदाः frightful, निर्ययुर्नैरृतव्याघ्रा fearless like tigers, निर्ययुः set out.

40016053.author: Translation
40016053.content: And others collected together holding shields, fearless like tigers, frightful in appearance, mounted on fast horses, chariots yoked to donkeys of different kinds covered with gold mesh, on maddened elephants Set out.

40016054.author: पदार्थः
40016054.content: खरनिःस्वनः of frightful tone, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, वृकसिंहमुखैः having faces like lion and bear, कनकभूषणै: adorned with gold, खरैः donkeys, युक्तम् yoked, दिव्यम् awesome, रथम् chariots, आरुरोह mounted.

40016054.author: Translation
40016054.content: Dhumraksha of frightful tone mounted on a chariot adorned with gold yoked to donkeys with lion and bear like faces.

40016055.author: पदार्थः
40016055.content: महावीर्यः heroic, सःधूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, वृतः surrounded by, प्रहसन् laughing, यत्र there, हनूमान् Hanuman, यूधपः taken position, पश्चिमद्वारं west gate, निर्यातः set forth.

40016055.author: Translation
40016055.content: Heroic Rakshasa, Dhumraksha surrounded by rakshasas set forth laughing to the west gate where Hanuman stood.

40016056.author: पदार्थः
40016056.content: खरयुक्तम् yoked to donkeys, खरस्वनम् braying like donkeys, रथप्रवरम् chariot, आस्थाय mounting, प्रयान्तम् while going, महाघोरम् terrible, भीमदर्शनम् fearful appearance, राक्षसम् at the Rakshasa, अन्तरिक्षागताः going to the sky, घोराः fierce, शकुनाः birds, प्रत्यषेधयन् stood before.

40016056.author: Translation
40016056.content: While the Rakshasa was mounted on the chariot and going braying like a donkey, a fearful bird going in the sky stood before his chariot.

40016057.author: पदार्थः
40016057.content: महान्भीमः very frightening, गृध्रश्च vultures, रथशीर्षे on the chariot, निपपातह descended on, कुणपाशनाः a foul smelling, ग्रथिताः vultures, ध्वजाग्रे from the chariot top, निपेतुः fell down.

40016057.author: Translation
40016057.content: A foul smelling frightening vulture (that feeds on the dead body) descended on top of the chariot and fell down.

40016058.author: पदार्थः
40016058.content: रुधिरार्द्रः drenched in blood, श्वेतः white, महान् great, कबन्धः bird, विस्वरम् discordant cry, नादम् sound, उत्सृजन् heard, धूम्राक्षस्य at Dhumraksha, समीपतः nearby, भुवि on ground, पतितः fell, देवः Deva, रुधिरम् , blood, ववर्ष rained, मेदिनी on earth.

40016058.author: Translation
40016058.content: A trunk of a white bird drenched in blood sounding discordant fell near by Dhumraksha. It appeared like a rain god shedding blood on the ground.

40016059.author: पदार्थः
40016059.content: रुधिरार्द्रः drenched in blood, श्वेतः white, महान् great, कबन्धः bird, विस्वरम् discordant cry, नादम् sound, उत्सृजन् heard, धूम्राक्षस्य at Dhumraksha, समीपतः nearby, भुवि on ground, पतितः fell, देवः Deva, रुधिरम् , blood, ववर्ष rained, मेदिनी on earth.

40016059.author: Translation
40016059.content: A trunk of a white bird drenched in blood sounding discordant fell near by Dhumraksha. It appeared like a rain god shedding blood on the ground.

40016060.author: पदार्थः
40016060.content: निर्घातसमनिस्वनः thunder like roar, वायुः wind, प्रतिलोमम् adversely, ववौ blew, तत्र there, दिशः directions, तिमिरौघवृताः darkness pervaded, नचकाशिरे directions could not be discerned.

40016060.author: Translation
40016060.content: Thunder like roar was heard. Wind blew adversely. Darkness pervaded, and directions could not be seen.

40016061.author: पदार्थः
40016061.content: राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, भयावहान् feared, तदा then, प्रादुद्भूतान् manifesting deities, घोरान् dreadful, उत्पातान् generated, दृष्टवा seeing, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, व्यथितः worried, अभवत् became, धूम्राक्षस्य Dhumraksha's, पुरःसराः in front, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, मुमुहुः lost consciousness.

40016061.author: Translation
40016061.content: Then Rakshasa feared seeing the dreadful manifestation and got worried. All the Rakshasas walking in front of Dhumraksha lost consciousness.

40016062.author: पदार्थः
40016062.content: ततः thereafter, सुभीमः very powerful, बली strong, बहुभिः many, निशाचरैः Rakshasas, वृतः surrounding, रणोत्सुकः enthusiastic of war, अभिनिष्क्रम्य, राघवबाहुपालिताम् protected by Raghava, महौघकल्पाम् universal dissolution, बहुवानरीम् many Vanaras, तांचमूम् the army, ददर्श beheld.

40016062.author: Translation
40016062.content: Thereafter many strong and powerful Rakshasas surrounding Dhumraksha, who was enthusiastic about war, beheld many Vanaras protected by Raghava like at universal dissolution. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty first sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
